insights.one_liner: War Child is an international NGO supporting children affected by armed conflict, with a recognised-sponsor Amsterdam foundation and globally spread teams.

culture.text: The War Child Alliance provides psychosocial support, child protection, youth programmes and education for children affected by armed conflict.
Team members are spread across different locations in global teams.

open.text: Stichting War Child and Stichting War Child Alliance are IND recognised visa sponsors.

worth_knowing.text: War Child is working in earthquake-hit Colombia, helping children cope with nightmares, fear and stress.
